integrity: Statements and finite exhaustive checks are reproducible using the two included Python programs; infinite-family claims use a mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite labeled world sets; constant nonempty domains; only paired unary mention-some questions.
Known convex-set count and two-Sperner inequality are credited prior ingredients, not new claims.
No conclusion about general monadic compactness or recursive axiomatizability.
Historical priority of the refined cost statistic is not independently certified.
title: Sharp individual-witness budgets for paired monadic mention-some questions
